title: Spike: Technology Stack
purpose: Confirm the technology stack implied by the specification.

questions.label: Stack
questions.prompt: What technology stack will be used? Include language, framework, and key dependencies.

questions.label: Deployment Target
questions.prompt: Where will this run? (e.g., AWS Lambda, self-hosted Docker, desktop app, CLI tool)

questions.label: Stack Constraints
questions.prompt: Any mandatory libraries, platforms, or version requirements? (e.g., must use Python 3.11+)
